title: ３Ｄモデリング
subtitle: Computer Aided Design and Modeling
teachers:
KANAHIRA Katsufumi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Students will learn about machine designs, including functional and performance designs, and manufacturing processes. Students also create design plans and drawings that meet the required specifications. In this course, students will create a design for strength and reliability that follows the engineering drawing, a manufacturing design that considers the manufacturing method and cost, and a draft that represents the mechanism and overall configuration utilizing the three-dimensional computer aided design (3D-CAD) system.
advice:
The main mechanism studied in this course is a three-axis two-stage helical gear reducer. We will use it to acquire the ability to systematically design machines through designing function, performance, accuracy, strength, and reliability. utilizing 3D-CAD system for embodiment of machine elements.
Basically, lectures and exercises are held weekly. However, the design and drafting of assigned tasks will not be completed in the practice time during the lecture, so preparation and review as homework will be necessary. In addition, students will use the basics of 3D-CAD software that were taught in “Mechanical Elements Design”, “Mechanical Drawing I” and “Mechanical Drawing II” that they attended before taking this course.
It is assumed that you have mastered the operating and reference methods of the JIS drawing textbook, so please check this material carefully before taking this course.
The topics covered in this course are as follows:
(1) Mechanical design and design process improvement; (2) Design problems, design concepts, and basic design; (3) Design problem strength, reliability of design, and detailed design; (4) 3D-CAD mechanical drawing; (5) Inspection of mechanical design problem drawings; and (6) Self-inspection and third-party evaluation of mechanical design problems.
books:
Textbooks: New JIS Mechanical Drawing (6th edition), Morikita Publishing (in Japanese),   Mechanical Drawing, Kanazawa Institute of Technology (in Japanese),   Helical Reducer Design, Power-sha Publishing (in Japanese),   Mechanical Design of Helical Reducer (Exercise), Kanazawa Institute of Technology (in Japanese)
Reference books: None
Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge:
This course is intended as a design and drafting course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering in accordance with the courses of Mechanical Principles/Exercises, Mechanical Drawing I, Mechanical Drawing II, and Mechanical Element Design. Therefore, to participate in this course, the design and CAD drawing abilities acquired in these courses are required.
Before attending this course, it is recommended that you review the content acquired in previous courses. Persistent effort is necessary.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the implementation of mechanical design, and use 3D-CAD drawings to explain design images.
Be able to carry out design calculations, such as basic design and detailed design of components.
Be able to model a mechanism design and calculate its strength using a computer.
Be able to create 3D-CAD machine designs that consider manufacturing methods, according to the machine drafting
Be able to conceive new design solutions by integrating specialized fields of mechanical engineering.
Be able to learn the latest technology from local engineers, and organize and discuss assignments.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the substance and shape of the design according to the instructions and prepare an easy-to-read assembly drawing by applying it to your own design conditions. (2) Summarize the flow of design calculations in detail using a computer. (3) Understand design modeling and strength calculations according to the instructions. (4) Perform drawing of a 3D-CAD model of lower casing in addition to a 3D-CAD assembly model consisting of axes, gears, bearing and collar. (5) In designing according to the instructions, it is possible to derive a design solution. (6) Understand the design and problem-solving techniques presented by local engineers.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the content and shape of the design according to the instructions. (2) Summarize the flow of design calculations with a chart using a computer and perform design calculations according to the issues. (3) Understand design modeling and strength calculations according to the instructions. (4) Perform drawing of a 3D-CAD assembly model consisting of axes, gears, bearing and collar. (5) In designing according to instructions, derive design solutions. (6) Understand the design and problem-solving techniques presented by local engineers.
